# Unrolling a loop clones its body once per iteration, and the clone has to
# reach into the event handlers: the handler's body is folded against the
# iteration it belongs to.
#
# The clone copied the handler structs but shared the one *ir.Func behind them,
# so the first iteration's fold substituted its values into the shared body and
# every later copy found nothing left to substitute. Twenty keys on a keypad,
# each reporting the press of the first.

sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out app.sngl

grep 'main_pick\(state, "a"\)' out/index.html
grep 'main_pick\(state, "b"\)' out/index.html
grep 'main_pick\(state, "c"\)' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

func labels() => ["a", "b", "c"]

component main {
    var chosen = ""

    func pick(label string) {
        chosen = label
    }

    vbox {
        for var l = labels() {
            button(text=l, @click { pick(l) })
        }
        text(value=chosen)
    }
}
